scripts.build: npm run build -w @balcony/shared && npm run build -w @balcony/api && npm run build -w @balcony/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @balcony/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @balcony/api" "npm run dev -w @balcony/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @balcony/shared && npm run test -w @balcony/api && npm run test -w @balcony/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @balcony/shared && npm run typecheck -w @balcony/api && npm run typecheck -w @balcony/web
